title: Compact Mixer
name: Compact Mixer
description: A narrow mixer for big sessions, in a floating window: 80+ channels on one screen.
Each fader lane is also its meter, on LUNA's audio scale, with a dB ruler.
The selected channel (or any pinned one) opens wide with inserts, an EQ curve, sends and pan.
Filter by name, kind or colour, move channels in LUNA's order, transport bar, and a button to swap to LUNA's own Mixer.
